name: Being Discouraged
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of discouragement but offers divine encouragement rooted in God's presence and faithfulness. Believers are commanded to be strong and courageous, trusting that the Lord is always with them and will deliver those who love Him. God heals the brokenhearted and renews strength without weariness, inviting persistent prayer and confidence that all things work together for good according to His purpose.
